theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_ccb_cylinder_grouping
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (P : Grassmannian N n) (x : Euclidean N) (s Z : Finset (Euclidean N)) (d ρ S u : ℝ), (∀ y ∈ s, Grassmannian.project P y = x) → Z ⊆ s → 0 < d → (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ y' ∈ s, y ≠ y' → d ≤ ‖y - y'‖) → 0 < ρ → 0 ≤ S → S ≤ u * ρ → u ≤ 1 → (∀ y ∈ s, ∃ z ∈ Z, ‖y - z‖ ≤ S) → ∑ y ∈ s, μ (closedBall y ρ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < d / 2}) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + (2 ^ n - 1) * u) * ∑ y ∈ Z, μ (closedBall y (ρ + S) ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < d / 2 + S}) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ + S) ^ n
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
